```
--- PASS: TestWaitPopulatesTokensAndCost    (tokens carried, cost=0.28 for 1000 in/500 out @ 0.14/0.28 per 1K)

--- PASS: TestGitMetricsOverWindow          (2 commits / 2 files over window)
--- PASS: TestGitMetricsWindowExcludesOutside (commits dated outside window excluded)
--- PASS: TestGitMetricsErrorSafe           (empty workdir & non-git dir => 0/0, no crash)
--- PASS: TestCompletePersistsCommitsAndFiles (commits=3, files=7 in persisted JSONL)
--- PASS: TestEndToEndOutcomeMetrics        (spawn→Wait→Complete: record all non-zero)

ok  schedulerfix  1.109s   coverage: 96.2% of statements
```

Live end-to-end run (real git workdir, `go run ./cmd/demo`) — the exact record that used to persist zeros:

```json
{"tick_id":"tick-42","tokens":{"prompt_tokens":1200,"completion_tokens":800,"total_tokens":2000},
```
